title: Unlock Deeper Insights with Spyglass
summary: We are excited to announce the official launch of Spyglass, a powerful new tool designed to deliver comprehensive insights and enhance your operational effectiveness.

title: Enhanced File Management
summary: Effortlessly manage, upload, and customize the display of your files directly within the editor for a more powerful and personalized experience.

title: Your Window into Our Future: The New Public Roadmap
summary: Explore our brand-new public roadmap, offering a clear view of our latest achievements, upcoming features, and long-term plans to enhance your experience.

title: Effortless Checkboxes
summary: Effortlessly manage your tasks with our updated checkboxes, now bigger, easier to drag, and perfectly aligned with our modern design.

title: Enhanced Collaboration Experience
summary: Work seamlessly with your team as our updated editor now offers even clearer real-time collaboration and effortless syncing.

title: Enhanced Shared Discoveries and Collaboration
summary: Effortlessly discover and access all shared ideas and quests from your collaborators, making teamwork more integrated and productive within your search and visual insights.

title: Noeko Goes Open Source!
summary: Noeko is now fully open source, offering unparalleled transparency and inviting our users to actively shape its future.

title: Experience Noeko in Your Language
summary: We're excited to bring comprehensive international language support to Noeko, making your experience more accessible and intuitive for users worldwide.

title: Enhanced Themes & Personalization Options
summary: We are enhancing our current themes and introducing a wider array of exciting new options to personalize your experience.

title: Smarter Knowledge Exploration
summary: Effortlessly discover insights and streamline your workflow by applying powerful new filters to your knowledge graph, including options for tags, time windows, and shared items.

title: Smart Search and Personalized Knowledge Collections
summary: Gain ultimate control over your knowledge base by applying advanced filters and transforming your precise searches into personalized, savable collections for instant access.

title: Dynamic Content Views
summary: This feature introduces innovative display options for linked content, empowering you to structure your notes and ideas precisely as you think.

title: Noeko Unleashed: Self-Hosting and Flexible Plans
summary: Experience the freedom of hosting Noeko on your own infrastructure or choose from our new cloud-based plans, complete with enhanced features tailored to your needs.

title: Perfectly Timed Greetings
summary: We're excited to announce that your homepage greetings will now precisely reflect the actual time of day, providing a warm and accurate welcome every single time.

title: Streamlined Tag Management Actions
summary: Effortlessly manage your tagged content with new direct actions that enable quick unapplication of tags, deletion of items, or detailed viewing right from your tag lists.

title: Unlock More Content Possibilities
summary: Soon you'll be able to effortlessly capture and analyze insights from a wider array of content, including YouTube videos, websites, and text files, making your research more comprehensive and powerful.
